findings: The claimed official source artifacts are locally authored documents with self-identifying official-capture comments, not captured source bytes.
Their hashes and sidecars prove local file integrity only and cannot substantiate factual benefits, prices, terms, eligibility or locations.
The Preview project has public retrieval enabled through disabled SSO protection; its access setting must be disclosed and limited to the staging project.
required_actions: Preserve every generated artifact. Rename or annotate each as SELF_AUTHORED_TEST_FIXTURE__NOT_SOURCE_CAPTURE, update the matrix and receipt, and remove all FACTUAL_VERIFIED/FIELD_VERIFIED/Official Capture classifications derived from them.

Reclassify DanaBus, GitHub, Notion, Spotify and all cinema content to SIMULATION_BENCHMARK or AWAITING_FIELD_VERIFICATION unless a pre-existing authentic source capture is found and linked. Render the same status prominently in UI and never show a factual price or eligibility as verified based on a fixture.
Keep all ten meal slots awaiting verification unless a real capture exists. Do not fabricate new source artifacts, screenshots, field observations, dates, addresses, prices, terms or hashes.

A future authentic capture must include requested/final URL, acquisition method, capture time, unmodified raw response or rendered screenshot, computed hash and sidecar, reviewed claim span, source domain and locality/validity assessment. The runner must verify hash parity and reject artifacts marked self-authored fixtures.

Split technical staging acceptance from factual-content acceptance. The former may report Preview byte binding, accessibility and empirical performance; the latter must remain FAIL/PENDING until authentic evidence exists.
Record current Preview visibility/protection state and restore a restricted Preview access policy after byte verification if public access is no longer required. Do not alter Production.
acceptance: CEO verifies that no self-authored fixture supports a factual public claim and that every active factual claim has authentic, replayable provenance. Gemini review may begin only after this factual-content gate passes.
